request: 发布整个项目之前，删除可识别具体 KOL 的信息，并检查实际发布文件与 Git 历史。
checks: Scan file contents and names, including Unicode-escaped identifiers
Reject creator attributions, source account metadata and social source links
Reject private source mappings, raw transcripts and unreviewed binaries
Accept anonymous methods and current official documentation links
Check the exact Git tree selected for publication
Report historical findings separately from current working tree findings
Never echo matched identities, credentials or source text in audit output
